$comment: `windowsPending`: the workspace members that build on Linux but don't compile for Windows yet, each declaring `platforms = ["linux", "macos"]` in its manifest. Every member off this list must compile for Windows: the Windows lane's clippy selects it there (docs/tooling/ci.md § Windows lane). A strict ratchet: `workspace-member-coverage` fails on a restricted member this list doesn't name, and a local run drops an entry once its member builds on Windows. Adding one needs David's OK (scripts/check/checks/DETAILS.md § Allowlist consent). Each reason is where the Windows break report stopped the member when it was listed (seeded 2026-11-11 from an `x86_64-pc-windows-gnu` cross-check); the lane's latest report is the current answer.

windowsPending.cmdr: blocked by `cmdr-fs`, `usearch`'s build script, and an unconditional `xattr` dependency
windowsPending.cmdr-fs: fails in its own code (66 errors, mostly `std::os::unix` imports)
